item.title: What a claim status means
item.body: A claim status shows where your insurer reports the claim is in its process, such as received, in process, paid or denied. A status is information from the insurer as of the date shown. It is not a guarantee of eligibility, coverage or payment. Questions about a coverage decision go to your insurer or to a billing specialist.
